items.b: FIVE RAPI SIZES SIT BELOW PEAKS SET IN LATE SEPTEMBER
items.t: Every size on Rapaport's daily series is higher over the 30 days to 4 October, and every one is below a peak set between 21 and 26 September. The 0.30-carat sits 1.26% under its own.

items.b: ELEVEN INDIAN EXHIBITORS FILL GJEPC'S SHARJAH PAVILION
items.t: The India Pavilion sits inside the 58th Watch & Jewellery Show Middle East at Expo Centre Sharjah, which runs to 4 October. Organisers expect more than 66,000 visitors from 52 countries.

items.b: GOLD SHEDS $144.40 ON THE WEEK TO CLOSE AT $4,139.80
items.t: All four precious metals fell between the settled marks for 25 September and 2 October. Palladium lost the most in percentage terms at 7.91%, silver 6.07%, platinum 4.62%.
